GAYATHRI JAYAN
Kochi, Kerala , India | gayathrijayan62@gmail.com | 9946238090 | Github | Linkedin
Career Objective
Motivated Computer Science Engineering student at SCMS School of Engineering and Technology, Kochi, with
strong fundamentals in Java, Python, C, SQL and Linux basics. Hands-on experience in web development, AI-based
systems, and backend logic through internships and academic projects. Seeking an entry-level role at Aurus Tech Pvt
Ltd, where I can contribute to real-world projects, strengthen my technical expertise, and grow within a professional
software environment.
Education
• SCMS School of Engineering and Technology, Ernakulam.
Btech Computer Science Engineering.
8.57 CGPA till semester 6.
• FACT Udyogamandal School, Ernakulam.
Plus two .
91%.
Technical Skills Soft Skills
• Python, Java, C • Teamwork & Collaboration
• SQL • Critical Thinking
• Git, GitHub, FAISS • Empathy & Active Listening
• HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap • Quick Learning & Adaptability
Experience
Internship
• Intern – Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence, ICT Academy of Kerala
Oct 14, 2024 – Nov 18, 2024
Built ML models using supervised learning and worked on data preprocessing, model training, and
evaluation.
Engineered components of an AI/ML pipeline, gaining exposure to chatbot and generative AI solutions.
• Intern – Web Development, Hostcurator IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Kochi
June 5, 2025 – June 21, 2025
Designed and developed responsive websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Implemented client requirements into functional UI features ensuring clean and maintainable code.
Projects
• CyberTrace – Explainable RAG-Based Chatbot for Cyber Threat Intelligence
Developed an AI-powered chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and FAISS for efficient
information retrieval. Built a modular Python backend and Streamlit interface for cybersecurity insights
with SHAP-based explainability.
• EchoHands – Sign Language to Text Conversion System
Developed and deployed a computer vision-based system to translate sign language gestures into text.
Integrated real-time hand detection using OpenCV and MediaPipe to enhance accessibility for the deaf and
hard-of-hearing community.
Certifications
• Infosys springboard Internet Of Thing 101 Certification
• IBM SkillsBuild Data Analytics: Training Data into Decisions using Python
• Cybersecurity Virtual Experience – Deloitte Australia (Forage)
Extracurricular
• Volunteered as host for the Computer Science Department Association Day program.
• Participated in TinkerHack – a women-only hackathon hosted by TinkerHub.
• Participated in Useless Projects - Makeathon by TinkerHub
